recipe.title: Cottage cheese vegetable frittata
steps: Slice the mushrooms and dice the red pepper.
Heat the oil in a small non-stick pan and cook the mushrooms and pepper for 4 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted, about 1 minute.
Whisk the eggs with the cottage cheese, salt and pepper.
Pour over the vegetables, cover and cook on low heat for 6 to 7 minutes until set.
Slide onto a plate and eat.
